content:
Maya (release): FYI Eval team is flagging a quality regression for llama3-q v4 checkpoint after runtime 3.3.0 + SDK 2.8.1 rolled. Not a crash, but embeddings drifted on our eval suite. Thinking temporary model pin to v3-checkpoint for affected customers in APAC while we investigate.
Omar (mlops): Confirmed on drift metric: cosine sims down ~6% on long-history prompt set for v4 when served on runtime 3.3.0. On 3.2.x the numbers look normal.
Tara (eval): Repro steps: run embedding eval set with context history preserved (>10k tokens). v4 on 3.3 shows drift vs baseline. Attaching summary: accuracy drop concentrated on long prefix examples.
Jules (sdk): If we pin model version per-route we must ensure fallback doesn't mix runtimes/models. SDK routing supports model_version pin rules; I can create a per-project override scoped to region=apac.
Maya (release): Proposed mitigation: 1) deploybot apply regional model_version pin (model=llama3-q, version=v3-checkpoint) in apac for 4h; 2) SDK teams add routing label and audit; 3) Eval + MLOps keep triage for root cause (runtime kernel vs model export mismatch); 4) decide whether to unpin after 4h or extend.
Omar (mlops): Triage note: initial diff suggests a KV serialization change in runtime 3.3 altering cached embeddings for very long histories. We'll instrument and test a minimal patch path.
Jules (sdk): I'll push the override now and include Console label "apac-model-pin-6167890123". Also will add a safety that prevents mixing model v4 on 3.2 nodes.
Maya (release): deploybot, schedule pin now with 5m cooldown and include rollback playbook link https://go/internal/release/pins/unpin-playbook.
deploybot: Request received:
  action: model-pin
  model: llama3-q
  version: v3-checkpoint
  scope: region=apac
  window: 4h
  cooldown: 5m
  initiated_by: Maya (release)
deploybot: Running preflight...
ci-bot: Preflight OK: capacity headroom 20% in apac, no conflicting pins, routing graph healthy.
Jules (sdk): Override applied. Console label: "apac-model-pin-6167890123". Audit ID: aud-77b.
Tara (eval): Post-pin quick check: drift removed in APAC canary for 30 min run. Metrics now align with baseline.
Omar (mlops): Good. Continuing triage. If patch is low-risk we'll coordinate a 3.3.1 runtime rollout and then lift pin.
Maya (release): Thanks everyone. I'll post a short release note/incident blurb and inform CS. Reopen this thread if we need to extend the window or rollback. :white_check_mark:
